app.name: Universe Explorer
app.footer: Fan-made portfolio project. Characters and trademarks belong to their respective owners.

home.lead: Pick a universe to explore. Each one is powered by a different public API and has its own interface, typography and personality.

rick-and-morty.tagline: Browse every character across infinite dimensions.

pokemon.tagline: Catch, compare and inspect creatures and their stats.

star-wars.tagline: Explore people, planets and starships of the galaxy.

harry-potter.tagline: Look up witches, wizards and magical creatures, house by house.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: These coordinates don't match any known universe.

routeError.title: Something went wrong
routeError.description: An unexpected error broke this view. Reloading usually fixes it.

network.title: Connection problem
network.description: We couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.

timeout.title: This is taking too long
timeout.description: The server didn't respond in time. Try again in a moment.

rateLimit.title: Too many requests
rateLimit.description: The API is limiting requests right now. Wait a few seconds and try again.

server.title: The API is having trouble
server.description: The server returned an error. Try again in a moment.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.description: An unexpected error occurred while loading this content.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.description: Content will load automatically as soon as you're back online.
